name: herdr-caffeinate
description: Keeps the Mac awake while this session has background commands or subagents that matter (builds, tests, deploys), not for dev servers; /awake shows and overrides.

showStatus.title: Show status line
showStatus.description: Pin '☕ awake · N background tasks' under the prompt while holding.

unknownFallback.title: Unclassified commands
unknownFallback.description: What to do with a background command that could not be classified once its 120 s grace passes.

hardCapHours.title: Hard cap (hours)
hardCapHours.description: Stop holding for a task after this many hours (0 = never; a long build is otherwise never dropped for age).

herdrRegistry.title: Write the herdr-caffeinate registry
herdrRegistry.description: Also record tasks where the herdr plugin's daemon reads them. Only needed if you run that plugin.

stuckAfterHours.title: Possibly stuck after (hours)
stuckAfterHours.description: A task holding the Mac awake this long raises a toast once; it keeps holding.
